title: 2D Contour wall-side ramp runs on the ring before G41/G42 engages, so control and wear compensation do not apply to it

labels.name: P1
labels.description: Unsafe or wrong output: gouge, collision, wrong G-code, crash, data loss; blocks a cut

labels.name: source:agent
labels.description: Opened by an AI agent (not a human reporter)

labels.name: effort:high
labels.description: Several crates, new behaviour with tests; safety floor (issue-worker-high)

body:
Found in the post-merge safety review of PR #3833 (merged 2026-11-24, Fixes #3829).

## What happens

An outside 2D Contour with entry Ramp or Helix now ramps onto each level by a zig-zag along the lead-in and the ring.

- `crates/motion/src/machining2d/contour_wall_ramp.rs` lines 45-47: the zig-zag path is `flatten(s.e2, &[lead, walk].concat())`. When the ramp run is longer than the lead-in, the legs go onto the ring, next to the finished wall.
- `crates/motion/src/machining2d/contour_step.rs` lines 127-134: `engage_level` posts these moves before the lead-in.
- `crates/motion/src/machining2d/contour.rs` lines 336-348: the compensation span starts at `walk_at - 1`, the lead-in move. `contour_comp::push_span` (`contour_comp.rs` lines 172-178) engages G41/G42 on that move.

The ramp moves are thus posted with G40 active, at the cutter centre that the generator calculated from the nominal tool diameter. `contour_comp::door` (`contour_comp.rs` lines 59-93) does not refuse a ramp or helix entry under control or wear compensation.

Example: a Linear lead-in of 5 mm, a 1 mm level step and a 3 deg ramp angle give a run of about 19 mm. One out-and-back leg is about 9.5 mm, so about 4.5 mm of each leg is on the ring.

## Why it is unsafe

Under control compensation the register holds the real tool radius. Under wear compensation it holds the wear delta. The operator sets these values to put the wall where the program says. The ramp moves on the ring do not get the register value:

- Control: if the real radius is larger than the nominal radius, the ramp cuts the wall by the difference.
- Wear: a positive wear value has the same result.

The finishing pass under G41/G42 cannot restore the cut material. The verifier and the simulation read the nominal centre moves, so the overcut passes silently. Before PR #3833, the wall side had only a graze dive at the lead-in start, which is away from the wall.

## Expected

Do one of these:

- Keep the wall-side ramp on the lead-in only when compensation is in the control. If the lead-in is too short, graze and say why.
- Or refuse a ramp or helix entry on the wall side under control or wear compensation, by name, in `contour_comp::door`.

The bore side (`contour_bore.rs` lines 124-133, `zig_onto` along the same path) has the same pattern. Check it in the same fix.

## Done means

- No feed move of a compensated outside contour runs on the ring outside the G41/G42 span, or the generator refuses the combination by name.
- A test in `crates/motion/tests/machining2d.rs` sets `Compensation::Control` and `Compensation::Wear` with entry Ramp and Helix on an outside contour. It fails on the current main.

Refs #3833, #3829.
